auth_description: Log in to your account to continue.
auth_login_error_description: Incorrect email or password. Please try again.
auth_login_to_signup: Don't have an account? Sign up
auth_forgot_description: Enter the email address associated with your account.
auth_forgot_sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link will be sent.
auth_forgot_error: Password recovery is unavailable right now. Please try again later or contact support.
auth_reset_description: Enter a new password for your account.
auth_reset_done: Your password has been reset. Please sign in again.
auth_reset_error: The reset link may be invalid or expired, or the request failed. Request a new link and try again.
auth_signup_delivery_error: Unable to send the sign-in email. Please try again later.
auth_signup_description: Create a new account to get started.
auth_signup_mail_sent_description: Please check your email to complete the sign-up process
auth_signup_to_login: Already have an account? Log in
component_role_switcher_role_user_descri: Standard features and content of the application
admin_workspace_networking_placeholder: Managed topology and link data arrives with the networking layer.
admin_workspace_networking_routing_place: Server-scoped routing rules arrive with the networking layer. Existing mixed-scope rules remain available under Client rules.
admin_networking_topology_list_hint: Use the arrow keys, Home and End to move between servers and links.
admin_networking_topology_no_match: No servers or links match the search.
admin_networking_topology_unresolved: {count} links reference missing servers or inbounds and are hidden.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_certificate: Optional. When empty, the destination's first active bound certificate is used for TLS.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_description: Create a managed peer link from a transit server to an exit server, reusing an existing listener or mirroring an exit node.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_full_forwar: The bridge was created, but full-traffic forwarding could not be saved.
Save a catch-all route from every transit subscriber inbound to the new peer link.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_mode_auto_c: Create a new exit peer inbound
admin_networking_auto_bridge_mode_hint: Choose whether the exit side creates a new listener, reuses one, or mirrors an existing subscriber node.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_mode_reuse: Reuse an existing exit peer inbound
admin_networking_auto_bridge_mode_uses_e: The exit listener and protocol come from the existing resource you select.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_network_hin: Leave on the protocol default unless you need to restrict the listener.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_no_inbounds: The destination server has no peer inbound to reuse.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_no_nodes: The destination server has no peer-capable subscriber node.
admin_networking_auto_bridge_required: Fill every required field before continuing.
admin_networking_activation_disabled_des: Draft links, routing and rule-set assets can be prepared. Applying a rollout stays disabled until managed networking is enabled and a supported agent is available.
admin_networking_apply_budget_blocked: The frozen intent exceeds the managed snapshot budget.
admin_networking_apply_claim_conflict: Another rollout still claims an affected server.
admin_networking_apply_config_version_co: An immutable config version already exists at the intended revision.
admin_networking_apply_conflict: A newer topology or managed revision replaced this plan. Reload and compare before retrying.
admin_networking_apply_failed: The rollout could not be admitted.
admin_networking_apply_readiness_blocked: Every affected agent must be online, supported and settled before admission.
admin_networking_apply_revision_conflict: A server's applied managed version changed before admission.
admin_networking_issue_certificate_gener: The peer listener certificate has no active generation.
admin_networking_issue_certificate_mater: Certificate {certificate} has no active material for the peer listener.
admin_networking_issue_credential_missin: Link {link} has no active peer credential.
admin_networking_issue_duplicate_link: This pair of servers already has a link to that peer inbound.
admin_networking_issue_empty_rule_scope: A rule must select at least one existing inbound.
admin_networking_issue_final_outbound_is: The fallback outbound cannot be a TCP-only peer link.
admin_networking_issue_inbound_not_found: Inbound {tag} is not available on this server.
admin_networking_issue_no_outbounds: No outbound is available for this server.
admin_networking_issue_outbound_not_foun: Outbound {tag} is not available on this server.
admin_networking_issue_peer_inbound_not_: The selected peer inbound no longer exists.
admin_networking_issue_peer_port_conflic: That listener port is already in use.
admin_networking_issue_referenced_resour: Another draft, link or rollout still references this resource.
admin_networking_issue_shadowed_rule: Rule {rule} is shadowed by an earlier catch-all rule {earlier}.
admin_networking_issue_stale_topology: The saved draft is stale or inconsistent. Reload before continuing.
admin_networking_issue_topology_conflict: Another topology change landed first. Reload and compare before saving again.
admin_networking_issue_udp_peer_route: A peer link carries TCP only, so this rule cannot route UDP.
admin_networking_issue_unknown_final_out: The fallback outbound {tag} does not exist.
admin_networking_issue_unknown_outbound: The rule targets an unknown outbound.
admin_networking_issue_unknown_rule_set: Rule-set tag {tag} has no imported asset.
admin_networking_issue_unresolved_destin: Destination IP matching with hostnames needs a resolve action.
admin_networking_links_delete_descriptio: The peer outbound draft and its credential generations are removed. A saved draft that still references the link blocks deletion.
admin_networking_links_description: A link connects one server's managed outbound to another server's peer inbound. Create it from either side; the receiver is staged first.
admin_networking_links_editor_descriptio: Pick a source, then an existing peer inbound or create one as part of the same draft.
admin_networking_links_editor_hint: The link editor keeps credentials encrypted at rest and never shows them in the browser.
admin_networking_links_field_network_hin: TCP, UDP, or both. Protocols with fixed transports ignore this.
admin_networking_links_field_tls_server_: The exact name the source verifies. It is separate from the listen and advertised addresses.
admin_networking_links_tls_not_required: This protocol does not use managed TLS; certificate and server name are not required.
admin_networking_links_list_description: Each row shows the managed outbound, credential generation, route references and the independently tracked rollout/peer-health state.
admin_networking_links_new_inbound_hint: Creates the destination listener first, then the link.
admin_networking_links_no_certificates: Create a certificate before adding a peer inbound.
admin_networking_links_required: Fill every required field before continuing.
admin_networking_load_error: The networking data could not be loaded.
admin_networking_no_servers: No servers yet. Create a server before managing networking.
admin_networking_port_forward_delete_des: The relay listener and its reserved port are removed from the transit server.
admin_networking_port_forward_descriptio: Relay raw TCP/UDP traffic from a transit server to a managed exit node or an external host. No tunnel encapsulation is added.
admin_networking_port_forward_dialog_des: A port forward listens on the transit server and overrides the destination to the selected node or host.
admin_networking_port_forward_enabled_hi: Disabled forwards stay in the graph but are not compiled.
admin_networking_port_forward_outbound_t: Optional outbound on the transit server. Leave empty to use the built-in direct egress.
admin_networking_port_forward_reason_por: That listen port is already in use on this server.
admin_networking_port_forward_reason_sel: A port forward cannot target its own transit listener.
admin_networking_port_forward_reason_tar: The target node no longer exists.
admin_networking_port_forward_required: Fill every required field before continuing.
admin_networking_readiness_config_not_ap: Agent has not applied its current configuration.
admin_networking_readiness_managed_state: A managed pointer is not confirmed yet.
admin_networking_readiness_sing_box_vers: Agent has not reported a sing-box version.
sing-box is older than the managed activation minimum.
admin_networking_rollout_abort_compensat: Rollout abort recorded; recovery proof is pending.
admin_networking_rollout_abort_descripti: Compensates the issued stage and holds claims until recovery is proven. A candidate may still be serving while recovery is pending.
admin_networking_rollout_description: Rollout state comes from the persisted journal. Stalled means the proof deadline passed; it never authorizes cleanup by itself.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_not_retr: This rollout has nothing to retry.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_paused: A disabled server paused this rollout.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_probe_ca: The source agent lacks the link-probe capability.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_probe_cr: The probe link has no active credential.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_probe_de: The probe destination stage is missing.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_probe_li: The probe link no longer matches the stage.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_probe_st: The stage must be confirmed before a probe can be issued.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_rollout_: The rollout is no longer active.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_stage_co: A newer stage attempt replaced this view.
admin_networking_rollout_reason_topology: Another topology change landed first. Reload before retrying.
admin_networking_routing_description: Rules evaluate in order and are scoped to selected inbounds. The fallback and TCP-only peer behaviour are shown exactly as the compiler emits them.
admin_networking_routing_diff_descriptio: Identifier-only comparison with the last saved draft. Credentials never appear here.
admin_networking_routing_effective_descr: Evaluation order, including sniff/resolve actions, the generated UDP reject for TCP-only peer routes, peer default rejects and the final fallback.
admin_networking_routing_final_fallback: Final fallback for every matched ingress.
admin_networking_routing_final_hint: The fallback must be direct or a named direct profile. Peer links are TCP-only terminal routes.
admin_networking_routing_final_invalid: Choose a valid non-peer fallback outbound.
admin_networking_routing_last_saved: The saved snapshot is the comparison baseline. Apply stays with the rollout workflow.
admin_networking_routing_no_rules: No rules yet. The fallback still applies to every selected ingress.
admin_networking_routing_peer_default_re: Peer ingress rejects unmatched traffic until a policy is configured.
admin_networking_routing_peer_udp_reject: Generated reject for the remaining UDP/QUIC traffic through this peer catch-all.
admin_networking_routing_plan_descriptio: A receiver-first plan computed from the current topology. Preview writes nothing; Apply records these immutable stages and claims the affected servers.
admin_networking_routing_plan_empty: Plan a rollout to see the stage order, dependencies and expected interruptions.
admin_networking_routing_plan_budget_blo: Blocked by the managed snapshot budget.
admin_networking_routing_plan_cycle: The managed forwarding graph contains a cycle.
admin_networking_routing_plan_handoff: Apply freezes these stages and claims the affected servers. Retry and Abort act on the persisted rollout; stage issuance, probes and agent notification stay with the rollout reconciler.
admin_networking_routing_plan_listener: Listener set changes; the agent applies a candidate and may restart the listener.
admin_networking_routing_plan_route: Peer route changes; existing connections are preserved where the runtime supports reload.
admin_networking_routing_plan_routing: Routing-only change through the staged config.
admin_networking_routing_rule_descriptio: Match groups are ANDed; values inside one group are ORed. Rule-set references use native sing-box expansion.
admin_networking_routing_rule_invert_hin: Route everything except the conditions above.
admin_networking_routing_rule_no_rule_se: Import a rule-set asset before referencing one.
admin_networking_routing_rule_outbound_h: A peer target carries TCP only. The compiler adds an ingress-scoped UDP reject for a peer catch-all.
admin_networking_routing_rule_resolve_hi: Choose a strategy when destination IP matching must resolve a hostname.
admin_networking_routing_rule_scope_hint: A rule with no existing scope is dropped; it never becomes a global match.
admin_networking_routing_rules_descripti: Reorder explicit rows with the arrow controls. Each ingress keeps its own evaluation scope.
admin_networking_rulesets_budget: Per-asset cap 512 KiB; 2 MiB aggregate per server; 6 MiB activation preview; 8 MiB live wire cap.
admin_networking_rulesets_description: Immutable binary rule-set assets with pinned versions and provenance. The server records the exact SHA-256 and size.
admin_networking_rulesets_field_version_: A new file always needs a new version; existing versions are immutable.
admin_networking_rulesets_file_hint: Attach one bounded .srs file. URLs and filesystem paths are never accepted.
admin_networking_rulesets_import_descrip: Choose a curated preset, pin its version and attach the exact asset. The browser reads the file locally.
admin_networking_rulesets_presets_descri: These presets carry metadata only. Attaching the asset records its integrity and makes it selectable in routing.
admin_networking_topology_canvas_descrip: Cards show directed managed links. Selecting a card or link opens details without changing the topology.
admin_networking_topology_description: Servers, managed outbounds and peer links. Incoming peer listeners are infrastructure, never subscriber entrances.
admin_networking_topology_list_section_d: Keyboard equivalent of the cards. Arrows, Home and End move one roving selection.
admin_networking_topology_no_route_refs: No route rule references this link yet.
admin_networking_topology_select_prompt: Select a server or link to inspect it.
admin_networking_validation_blocked: The draft has blocking validation issues.
admin_networking_write_credential_key_un: Peer credentials cannot be encrypted until the certificate master key is configured.
admin_networking_write_asset_too_large: The asset must be between 1 byte and 512 KiB.
admin_networking_write_invalid_asset: The SRS file is not valid canonical base64.
admin_networking_write_duplicate_rule_se: That rule-set version is already imported.
admin_networking_write_invalid_link: A link must target another server.
admin_networking_write_port_exhausted: No free listener port could be allocated on the destination server.
admin_networking_write_unsupported: This operation is not supported for that resource.
admin_servers_outbounds_custom_descripti: Dial an external sing-box proxy. Secret fields are encrypted at rest and never returned.
admin_servers_outbounds_custom_edit_hint: Saved secrets are not shown. Re-enter required credentials before saving.
admin_servers_outbounds_custom_protocol_: Every protocol is derived from the sing-box schema.
admin_servers_outbounds_delete_descripti: Only an unreferenced direct profile can be deleted. Peer outbounds are removed with their link.
admin_servers_outbounds_description: The built-in direct egress remains the legacy default. Named direct profiles and peer links carry their route references and revision.
admin_servers_outbounds_direct_descripti: A named direct outbound may bind an interface and an IP family. Other dial fields stay at sing-box defaults.
admin_servers_outbounds_field_interface_: Leave empty to use the host default.
admin_servers_outbounds_field_ip_hint: Pins the direct dial family without changing destination resolution policy.
admin_servers_outbounds_group_descriptio: A selector or urltest group over outbounds on this server.
admin_servers_outbounds_group_members_hi: Select at least one outbound. Members keep the order shown.
admin_servers_outbounds_group_members_re: Select at least one member outbound.
admin_servers_outbounds_group_protocol_h: selector picks the first healthy member; urltest probes members and picks the fastest.
admin_servers_outbounds_group_urltest_hi: urltest probes each member by URL and selects the fastest.
admin_servers_outbounds_reason_member_no: A selected group member does not exist on this server.
admin_networking_preset_geoip_cn_descrip: Country-level IPv4/IPv6 CIDR set for China.
admin_networking_preset_geosite_cn_descr: Curated China domain and suffix set.
admin_networking_preset_geoip_private_de: RFC private and loopback address ranges.
admin_networking_preset_geosite_private_: Private, loopback and local domain suffixes.
admin_proxies_servers_delete_description: This permanently removes the server and its agent token. Any remaining nodes must be deleted or moved first. This action cannot be undone.
admin_proxies_servers_delete_blocked: This server still has nodes; move or delete them first.
agent_terminal_description: Open an interactive shell through this server's enrolled agent. The session runs with the agent process's OS permissions.
agent_terminal_unavailable_offline: The agent must be connected over WebSocket before a terminal can open.
agent_terminal_unavailable_unsupported: This agent is connected but does not advertise terminal support. Set AGENT_PTY_ENABLED=true and run the agent as its non-root service account.
agent_terminal_opt_in_note: Terminal access is opt-in on the agent. Sessions are capped and close automatically when idle.
agent_terminal_confirm_description: This opens an interactive shell on the proxy server as the agent's OS user. Every command runs with that user's permissions, and the session start and end are recorded in the admin audit log. Continue?
agent_terminal_notice_backpressure: The terminal fell behind and was disconnected to protect the server.
agent_terminal_notice_socket_error: The terminal connection failed. Check that the agent is online and terminal access is enabled.
agent_terminal_notice_render_error: The terminal renderer failed to load: {message}
agent_terminal_identity: Runs as {user} using {shell}. The shell can read files this account can read.
agent_terminal_notice_denied: Terminal access was denied. Sign in as an administrator and try again.
agent_terminal_notice_probe_failed: Could not check whether the terminal is available. Try again.
agent_terminal_notice_closed_before_star: The connection closed before the shell started.
agent_terminal_reason_shell_unavailable: The shell could not start. Check the agent's AGENT_PTY_SHELL and AGENT_PTY_WORKING_DIR settings. {detail}
agent_terminal_reason_pty_unavailable: The host could not allocate a pseudo-terminal. {detail}
agent_terminal_reason_relay_timeout: The agent did not start the shell in time. Check that it is connected and responsive.
agent_terminal_reason_authorization_revo: Terminal access ended because your session or the agent connection changed.
agent_terminal_reason_session_limit: Another terminal session is already open for this server.
agent_terminal_reason_idle_timeout: The terminal closed after a period of inactivity.
agent_terminal_reason_session_expired: The terminal reached its maximum session length.
agent_terminal_reason_disabled: Terminal support is disabled on the agent.
agent_logs_description: Live and retained output from the server agent and its supervised sing-box process. Lines are redacted by the agent before they leave the host.
agent_logs_reconnecting_note: Reconnecting; retained lines stay visible until the stream resumes.
agent_logs_unavailable_disabled: This server is disabled, so its agent log stream is not available.
agent_logs_unavailable_offline: The agent is not connected over the v2 WebSocket. Logs return after it reconnects; historical settings and nodes stay available.
agent_logs_unavailable_unsupported: This agent is connected but does not advertise log tail or log search support.
agent_logs_unauthorized_description: Access to this log stream was denied. Your admin session may have expired; reload the page and sign in again.
agent_logs_tail_unsupported: Live tail is not available for this agent, but retained search still works.
agent_logs_filter_note: Filters are applied by the agent. Changing them clears the current view and restarts the tail.
agent_logs_empty_description: The agent's retained buffer has no entries in the current window. New lines appear here while the tail is following.
agent_logs_view_trimmed: This view dropped {count} older entries to stay bounded. Use search to inspect the retained buffer.
agent_logs_older_available: Showing the newest page. Older retained lines are available through search.
agent_logs_keyboard_hint: Use the arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End to move. Space selects a line, Enter opens its context, and F toggles following.
agent_logs_gap_restarted: Gap: the agent restarted and its retained buffer began a new generation.
agent_logs_gap_overwritten: Gap: lines {from}–{to} were overwritten in the retained buffer.
agent_logs_gap_dropped: Gap: the control plane dropped lines because this browser fell behind.
agent_logs_search_description: Search the redacted buffer on the agent, including entries older than the live view. Text is literal and case-insensitive; times are UTC.
agent_logs_search_unsupported: Retained search is not available for this agent. Live tail may still be available.
agent_logs_search_unavailable: Retained search is unavailable while the server is disabled or the agent is offline.
agent_logs_search_invalid_range: Enter valid times with “From” earlier than “Until”.
agent_logs_search_incomplete: This result is incomplete. The agent restarted or overwrote part of the requested range; run the search again for the current buffer.
agent_logs_search_empty: No matches in the retained window.
agent_logs_context_description: The matched line with a bounded set of surrounding lines from the same source and generation.
agent_logs_toast_nothing_selected: Select one or more lines to copy
agent_logs_toast_copy_error: Could not copy the selected lines
agent_logs_error_timeout: The agent did not answer before the request deadline.
agent_logs_error_busy: The agent is busy with another log request. Try again shortly.
agent_logs_error_offline: The agent is offline or the log relay is not connected.
agent_logs_error_forbidden: Access to the log stream was denied.
agent_logs_error_server_disabled: The server was disabled, so the log stream ended.
agent_logs_error_session_replaced: The agent session was replaced. The log stream is reconnecting.
agent_logs_error_unsupported: This agent does not support the requested log operation.
agent_logs_error_overwritten: The requested lines were overwritten in the retained buffer.
agent_logs_error_restarted: The agent restarted and the retained buffer changed generation.
agent_logs_error_not_found: The requested log record was not found.
agent_logs_error_invalid_request: The log request was rejected as invalid.
agent_logs_policy_description: Configured baselines, temporary overrides, and the effective level each source reports. Changes use the audited log-policy surface and never alter proxy subscriptions.
agent_logs_policy_load_error: Could not load log levels for this server.
agent_logs_policy_unsupported_descriptio: This agent does not advertise log-policy-v1. You can inspect the stored policy, but level changes stay disabled until the agent is upgraded.
agent_logs_policy_disabled_description: This server is disabled. Enable it before changing log levels.
agent_logs_policy_offline_description: The agent is offline. Changes are saved and remain pending until it reconnects.
agent_logs_policy_apply_error: The agent reported: {message} The last working configuration is retained and the agent retries.
agent_logs_policy_sing_box_warning: Changing sing-box's log level stages and reloads its configuration. Proxying can be briefly interrupted while the change is applied.
agent_logs_policy_duration_hint: Default 15 minutes. Allowed range: 0.5 to 60 minutes.
agent_logs_policy_duration_invalid: Enter a duration from 0.5 to 60 minutes.
agent_logs_policy_restore_now_for: Restore {source} to its configured baseline now
agent_logs_policy_restore_hint: Restore now clears only the temporary override. Restore installed default also clears the configured baseline.
agent_logs_policy_conflict_description: Another edit moved the policy revision before this change was saved. The current state was reloaded; retry to apply this change to the newer revision.
agent_logs_policy_toast_conflict: Log policy changed elsewhere; review the reloaded state and retry
agent_logs_policy_toast_error: Could not update the log level
admin_proxies_servers_token_description: Copy this token now — it is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. The agent uses it as a bearer token to pull this server's config (all of its inbounds) and report heartbeats.
admin_proxies_servers_token_docker_label: Or deploy the agent on the server host with a single Docker command:
admin_proxies_servers_form_description: Configure a proxy server host. The agent pulls one multi-inbound sing-box config covering every node on this server.
admin_proxies_servers_onboarding_descrip: Generate a one-time install command. The server is created automatically when the agent redeems it, so nothing is left behind if the command is never run.
admin_proxies_servers_onboarding_grants_: The install link is a one-time credential and expires after {minutes} minutes.
admin_proxies_servers_onboarding_create_: Could not generate the install command
admin_proxies_servers_onboarding_secret_: Treat the command as a credential
Anyone with this command can enroll one agent. The link expires and can be used once; do not paste it into tickets or logs.
admin_proxies_servers_onboarding_docker_: Runs the published container image with host networking, NET_ADMIN and the TUN device. Binaries and state live in the blossom-agent-data volume.
admin_proxies_servers_onboarding_host_de: Installs server-agent and sing-box on Linux amd64/arm64 and starts blossom-agent.service. Run as root.
admin_proxies_servers_onboarding_status_: Waiting for the agent to redeem this link.
The agent is redeeming the link…
The agent redeemed the link and the server was created.
This link expired. Generate a new install command.
This link was revoked. Generate a new install command.
admin_proxies_servers_field_backup_token: Off by default. OAuth is the primary agent credential. Enable this only for legacy agents that cannot use OAuth; the token is shown once and can be disabled from Connection.
admin_proxies_nodes_delete_description: This permanently removes the node. The agent pulls it down on the next sync. This action cannot be undone.
admin_proxies_nodes_form_description: Configure an inbound on a server. The agent pulls the compiled sing-box config (all of the server's inbounds) and hot-reloads.
admin_proxies_nodes_form_no_server_descr: Create a server before adding nodes; each node belongs to exactly one server.
admin_proxies_nodes_field_address_helper: Leave blank to use the server's address.
admin_proxies_groups_delete_description: This permanently removes the group and its node memberships. Plans bound to this group lose access to its nodes. This action cannot be undone.
admin_proxies_groups_toast_conflict: This group changed since you opened it. Compare the saved order and retry.
admin_proxies_groups_members_drop_empty: Drag entrances here or use Add.
admin_proxies_groups_members_no_matches: No available entrances match these filters.
admin_proxies_groups_members_no_availabl: No entrances are available to add.
admin_proxies_groups_members_missing_hin: {count} selected entrance IDs are not in the node list. Remove them here, or recreate the node on its server.
admin_proxies_groups_members_filter_note: Filters affect only the available column; every selected entrance stays visible.
admin_proxies_groups_members_order_hint: Drag or use the row buttons to set subscription order.
admin_proxies_groups_members_sr_instruct: To reorder, focus a drag handle and press Space or Enter, then use the arrow keys. Press Space or Enter to drop, or Escape to cancel.
admin_proxies_groups_members_sr_cancel: Cancelled moving {name}. The previous order was restored.
admin_proxies_groups_members_sr_dropped_: Dropped {name} into available entrances and removed it from the selection.
admin_proxies_groups_conflict_title: This group changed while you were editing
admin_proxies_groups_conflict_descriptio: Your save expected revision {expected}, but the server is at revision {current}.
admin_proxies_groups_conflict_load_faile: The latest saved group could not be loaded.
admin_proxies_groups_conflict_order_same: The saved and draft entrance sets and order match; only the revision changed.
admin_proxies_groups_conflict_draft_kept: Your draft, including all unsaved order and field changes, is kept.
admin_proxies_groups_conflict_reload_kee: Use latest revision, keep my draft
admin_plans_delete_description: This permanently removes the plan and its group bindings. This action cannot be undone.
admin_plans_delete_blocked: This plan has subscriptions and cannot be deleted
admin_users_ban_description: Bans the account and revokes its sessions. The user drops out of node configs when each agent next pulls.
admin_users_subs_delete_description: This permanently removes the subscription and its credentials. The user drops off the nodes on the next agent sync.
admin_users_subs_reset_description: New credentials take effect immediately; the old ones stop working when each node agent next pulls its config.
admin_users_subs_refresh_link_descriptio: The old link stops working immediately. Proxy credentials are not affected.
admin_users_subs_link_description: Import this URL in a Clash Meta client.
admin_users_assign_description: Creates a subscription with fresh credentials. Quota, duration and device limit are snapshotted from the plan.
admin_users_credentials_description: Embedded into node configs as the sing-box inbound user. UUID serves VLESS/VMess/TUIC; the password serves Trojan, Shadowsocks and the rest.
admin_users_search_placeholder: Search name, email or user ID
admin_users_select_all: Select all rows on this page
admin_users_export_truncated: Exported the first {count} users. Narrow the filters to export the rest.
admin_users_create_description: Creates an account. Without a password the user can only sign in through a magic link or a social provider.
admin_users_create_field_password_hint: At least 8 characters. Leave blank to create the account without a password.
admin_users_create_field_send_link_hint: Requires email delivery (RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_MAIL_FROM) to be configured.

landing_feature_subscription_description: A single link works with Clash Meta compatible clients. Paste it once to import your profile.
landing_feature_traffic_description: See how much traffic you have used and what is left on your plan from your dashboard.
landing_feature_nodes_description: Connections are served from several servers and nodes.
landing_feature_redeem_description: Have a code? Redeem it in your account to activate or extend a plan.
landing_step_1_description: Sign up with your email address.
landing_step_2_title: Get a plan or redeem a code
landing_step_2_description: Ask an administrator for a plan, or redeem a code you already have.
landing_step_3_title: Copy your subscription link into your client
landing_step_3_description: Find the link on your subscriptions page and paste it into a Clash Meta compatible client.
welcome_error_description: We could not load your subscription details. Please try again.
welcome_description: Three quick steps and you're ready to connect.
welcome_step_access_description: You need an active plan to connect. Redeem a code below.
welcome_access_admin_note: No code? An administrator can also assign a plan to your account.
welcome_step_subscribe_description: Open your subscriptions page and copy the link for the plan you want to use.
welcome_step_client_description: Use a client that supports Clash Meta (mihomo) profiles, for example:
welcome_step_client_tip: In your client, add a new profile from URL and paste the link.
admin_access_preview_empty_group: Select nodes to preview this group.
admin_access_preview_empty_plan: Select groups to preview their nodes.
admin_access_preview_no_nodes: The selected groups contain no nodes.
admin_access_preview_filtered: {count} disabled nodes or servers are excluded.
admin_access_preview_attention: {count} nodes need attention in their agent status.
admin_access_preview_missing: {count} selected nodes could not be found.
admin_access_preview_unknown_groups: {count} selected groups could not be found.
admin_access_preview_note: Status reflects the last agent report, not client connectivity. Changes may wait for deployment.
admin_access_new_tab_hint: Opens in a new tab; your selections stay here.
admin_access_impact_error: Could not load the impact of this change.
admin_access_group_used_summary: {plans} plans and {subscriptions} subscriptions reference this group.
admin_access_group_change_gate_added: Added entrances stay out of subscription links until each hosting server applies the change.
admin_access_group_change_gate_removed: Removed entrances disappear from links immediately unless another group in the same plan still includes them.
admin_access_group_change_order_only: Only the export order changes. Saving reorders client output without triggering an agent apply.
admin_access_snapshot_note: Existing subscriptions keep their saved traffic quota, device limit and expiry when plan settings change. Group membership changes affect access.
admin_access_device_not_enforced: Device limits are recorded but not currently enforced.
admin_access_unmetered_protocol: Per-user traffic for this protocol is not reported by the current agent.
user_device_not_enforced: Device limits are not currently enforced.
admin_access_group_delete_unused: No plan uses this group, so no subscription is affected.
admin_access_group_delete_used: It is used by plans: {plans}, with {subscriptions} subscriptions in total. Those subscriptions immediately lose the nodes that only this group provides from their subscription links.
admin_access_groups_empty_description: A group collects nodes. Plans give subscribers access to nodes through the groups they use.
admin_access_groups_empty_need_nodes: There are no nodes yet. Create a node first, then add it to a group.
admin_access_plan_delete_blocked_intro: The server will refuse to delete it because:
admin_access_plan_delete_blocker_trial: It is the new-user trial plan; choose another trial plan in Settings first.
admin_access_plan_delete_blocker_subscri: {count} subscriptions, including expired and cancelled ones, still use it.
admin_access_plan_delete_blocker_redeem_: This plan is used by redeem batches and cannot be deleted
admin_access_plan_delete_constraints: Deleting this plan is refused while any subscription or redeem batch ({batches} batches) refers to it, or while it is the new-user trial plan. The server checks again when you delete.
admin_access_plan_is_trial: It is currently the new-user trial plan.
admin_access_plan_groups_change_title: Unsaved group change for this plan's {count} subscriptions
admin_access_plan_groups_change_gate: Added nodes are withheld from subscription links until each hosting server's agent applies the change. Removed nodes disappear from links immediately, unless another group of this plan still includes them.
admin_access_plan_no_groups_hint: Subscriptions on this plan receive no nodes until a group is added.
admin_access_plan_snapshot_changed: You are changing {fields}. The {count} existing subscriptions keep their current values; only subscriptions created or moved onto this plan afterwards use the new ones.
admin_access_plan_subs_none: No subscription uses this plan yet.
admin_access_plan_subs_summary: {total} subscriptions use this plan, {active} currently active.
admin_access_plans_empty_description: A plan sets quota, duration and which groups of nodes a subscriber can use.
admin_access_plans_empty_need_groups: There are no groups yet. Create a group of nodes first, then bind it to a plan.
admin_access_assign_no_groups: This plan has no groups, so the subscription would not receive any nodes.
admin_access_assign_no_nodes: This plan's groups contain no node that is enabled on an enabled server, so the subscription would not receive any nodes.
admin_access_assign_nodes: Reaches {count} nodes ({attention} need attention in their agent status). A new subscription's nodes appear in its link only after the hosting agents apply it.
admin_subscriptions_empty_description: Subscriptions are created by assigning a plan to a user, from a redeem code or by the trial.
admin_subscriptions_empty_need_plans: There are no plans yet. Create a plan before assigning subscriptions.
